description: A React component that renders a themed, accessible bar chart showing deployment counts by status, with support for loading/error states, custom tooltips, and interaction logging.

classes.name: CustomTooltip
classes.description: A custom tooltip component for displaying deployment status and count information on hover.

classes.name: ValueLabel
classes.description: A component for rendering value labels above each bar in the chart.

methods.name: auditLogInteraction
methods.description: Logs user interactions such as bar clicks and legend clicks for auditing purposes.
